definitions.gloss: as expected, sure enough, I knew it
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something turned out as anticipated or confirms a suspicion.

definitions.gloss: after all, in the end, still
definitions.explanation: Indicates a return to an original idea or preference after consideration.

examples.japanese: やっぱ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦{降|ふ}ってきた→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: It started raining, just as I expected.
He really is a genius, isn't he.

examples.japanese: やっぱ⟦やめとく→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、やっぱ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ことにした→ことにする：10986_kotonisuru⟧。
examples.english: I thought about it, but I decided to go after all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べてみたら→てみる：30510_temiru⟧、やっぱ⟦{美味|おい}しかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: When I tried it, it was good, just as I expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、やっぱ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was going to have coffee, but I'll have tea after all.

notes:
REGISTER: Casual, spoken. A contracted form of ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧.

FORMALITY SCALE:
- ⟦やはり→やはり：01991_yahari⟧: formal, written
- ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧: neutral, standard
- やっぱ: casual, spoken

COMMON PATTERNS:
- やっぱ〜⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: "X is really ~ as expected"
- やっぱ⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: "I'll cancel after all"
- やっぱ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧: "It's impossible after all"

CHANGING ONE'S MIND: Often used when reversing a decision:
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧、やっぱ⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？ (Can I change my order after all?)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧: standard form
- ⟦やはり→やはり：01991_yahari⟧: formal form
- ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧: "in the end" (more conclusive)
- ⟦{案|あん}の{定|じょう}→案の定：07578_annojou⟧: "as expected" (more literary)
